ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

3. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.

4. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
